title: Stop waiting for the free hour. Your ten minutes already came
caption: How to work out when you have no time: stop waiting for the free hour and use the ten minutes already in your day. Sit-to-Stand, Wall Push-Up and Glute Bridge, three rounds, done. Save this for your ten minutes.

overlays.text: Stop waiting for the free hour. Seriously. It is not coming.

scenes.footer: That is the calendar, not you.

overlays.text: The free hour has not come since you started waiting for it.
Your calendar already has ten minutes in it. Between calls. Before pickup.

scenes.footer: Not a warm-up for a real one.

overlays.text: Ten minutes. Three moves. Done. That is a complete session.

scenes.footer: A chair, a wall, the floor. Rest as you need.

overlays.text: Sit-to-Stand, 8 reps. Wall Push-Up, 10 reps. Glute Bridge, 10 reps. Three rounds.
Ten minutes today, ten tomorrow. The strength you build is yours.

scenes.footer: Save this for your ten minutes.

overlays.text: Where are your ten minutes today?
